blockers.finding: started is not an existing DDL lifecycle enum; precise active checkpoint/roomfacts/auth-generation and effect sequence contract is not frozen.
blockers.required: Map semantic started to explicit existing lifecycle/phase/fields; define generation0 or trusted takeover, receipt/audit/outbox identities and no playback permission. Do not silently change DDL.

blockers.finding: created-only/version/generation checks can reject legitimate command replay unless receipt lookup precedes new-transition CAS.
blockers.required: Authorize current owner first, lookup matching receipt next, and apply created/CAS checks only to a missing receipt; replay returns facts without fresh output authority.

blockers.finding: Rejecting all concurrent live configuration changes conflicts with frozen creation config/words contract.
blockers.required: Use original frozen creation content for Start. Reject revoked owner or changed checkpoint/generation/schema, not unrelated live config changes. Bind stable candidate inputs and creation content fingerprint.

blockers.finding: Blanket prohibition on transactional tool invocation conflicts with docs33 tx-bound trusted tools/audit; prebuilt audit must not impersonate executed tools.
blockers.required: Separate outside-transaction Teacher planning from allowed pure tx-bound capability validation/execution and atomic audit. Define adapter and exact effect tools; never reuse nested callAgentTool or global services.

compatible_boundaries: No production pilot creation or real model/media route
nonblocking: Choose actual test-only persistence harness, not mocked success, for E2E
not_found alone does not prove rollback
Keep shared-DB deletion and finished-read-only gaps open
execution: Read-only; no tests, builds, services or production changes. Only these review reports were created.
